comments.author: @VidaRealViajes
comments.text: Living off the ocean and cooking traditional island meals looks like the ultimate way of life! Nothing beats the satisfaction of fresh seafood and pure island freedom. Experiencing that rugged Pacific lifestyle must be an incredible rush!

replies.author: @BestHiddenPlaces
replies.text: Absolutely! That connection between the ocean, food, and community makes life in Vanuatu so special. Which would you most like to experience—the fishing, traditional cooking, or village life?
